Summary: HR-01: As an employee, I can raise an HR request from one portal so I don't need to know who to email
Description:
As an employee, I can raise an HR request from one portal so I don't need to know who to email

Acceptance criteria: Portal reachable via SSO; 12 request types; confirmation email sent

Summary: HR-02: As an HR agent, I see a shared queue sorted by SLA so nothing is missed
Description:
As an HR agent, I see a shared queue sorted by SLA so nothing is missed

Acceptance criteria: Queue by request type; SLA timer 1 business day for first response

Summary: HR-03: As an employee, I can raise a confidential concern that only investigators can see
Description:
As an employee, I can raise a confidential concern that only investigators can see

Acceptance criteria: Separate restricted project; only 'HR Investigator' role can view; tested with 5 non-authorised roles

Summary: HR-04: As an employee, I sign in with my bank account (SSO) and my details auto-fill
Description:
As an employee, I sign in with my bank account (SSO) and my details auto-fill

Acceptance criteria: SSO works for 100% of test users; department and manager auto-populated

Summary: HR-05: As an employee, I see suggested articles before submitting
Description:
As an employee, I see suggested articles before submitting

Acceptance criteria: Top 3 articles suggested from keywords

Summary: HR-06: As an employee, I can email hr@ and a ticket is created
Description:
As an employee, I can email hr@ and a ticket is created

Acceptance criteria: Email creates ticket in under 2 min; reply threads stay on the ticket

Summary: HR-07: As an HRBP, tickets from 'my' departments are routed to me first
Description:
As an HRBP, tickets from 'my' departments are routed to me first

Acceptance criteria: 'Preferred adviser' field routes by department; falls back to queue after 4 h

Summary: HR-08: System warns and re-routes when a general ticket contains sensitive keywords
Description:
System warns and re-routes when a general ticket contains sensitive keywords

Acceptance criteria: Keywords (e.g., grievance, harassment) trigger restricted re-route + Privacy Officer alert

Summary: HR-09: As HR leadership, I see volume, SLA and top themes monthly
Description:
As HR leadership, I see volume, SLA and top themes monthly

Acceptance criteria: Dashboard with 4 charts; data matches queue export

Summary: HR-10: As an employee, I rate my experience when a ticket closes
Description:
As an employee, I rate my experience when a ticket closes

Acceptance criteria: 1–5 rating; 1-click

Summary: HR-11: Virtual agent answers common questions
Description:
Virtual agent answers common questions

Acceptance criteria: —
